note: Site updates for @catcosanctuary on X, posted one a run by scripts/post-updates.mjs, in this order, after any adoption not posted yet (data/adoptions.json), at least minGapMinutes apart and 15 minutes after the announcer's last post. Add a post with approved: true and status: queued; the script records the rest. The sanctuary's launch posts go earliest launch first; a ticker in launchesFirst goes ahead of the rest.

posts.text:
🧺 Adopted cats now show up by themselves 🐾
When a visitor launches a cat straight from its Adopt kit, the sanctuary spots it and its card turns Adopted, with its mint 🔍
And we'll cheer every adoption right here 🎉
https://catcoinsanctuary.com/
#catcoin #CatsOfX

🏆 Have you visited the Hall of Fame? It's out by the fountain ⛲
Legendary cat coins that already exist, made by others, in the garden as inspiration ✨
They aren't ours and they aren't up for adoption, just there to inspire 😼
https://catcoinsanctuary.com/
#catcoin

🚩 Copycat check 🚩
Strangers sometimes launch coins with our cats' names and tickers.
✅ Only the mint shown on a cat's card is real
❌ No mint on the card = no coin yet
Anything else is a copycat. Stay safe 🐾
https://catcoinsanctuary.com/
#catcoin

🏡 How Catcoin Sanctuary works 🐾
🐱 A 3D garden of famous cats, each with its real story
🧺 Adopt one: its kit lets you launch its coin yourself
🔥 Trending on X? Our bot launches it
✅ Only the mint on a cat's card is real
https://catcoinsanctuary.com/
#catcoin

🐾 Sanctuary trivia 1/5
The cottage in the garden has cat-ear gables 🏡😺
It's Research HQ, where every cat's story gets checked before it moves in 🔍
https://catcoinsanctuary.com/
#catcoin #CatsOfX

🐾 Sanctuary trivia 2/5
No made-up lore here 📜
Every cat's card lists the posts and articles behind its story, each with a date. If we couldn't find it, the card says so 🔍
https://catcoinsanctuary.com/
#catcoin

🐾 Sanctuary trivia 3/5
Some residents live on in loving memory 🕯️
Tama the station master cat and Tombili of Istanbul both have a home in the garden 🌿
https://catcoinsanctuary.com/
#CatsOfX

🐾 Sanctuary trivia 4/5
The cats keep their own schedule 😸
They wander, play, eat, groom and nap in the sun, among the birds, butterflies and the pond 🦋
Catch one mid-nap 😴
https://catcoinsanctuary.com/
#CatsOfX

🐾 Sanctuary trivia 5/5
The whole 3D garden runs in your browser 🌐
No app, no sign-up: everything it shows loads from the sanctuary's own site 🐾
https://catcoinsanctuary.com/
#catcoin

🐾 Catcoin Sanctuary now launches its coins through @UsePaid 🎁

Every new coin's creator fees go to the X account the cat's story came from, not to us 🐈

https://catcoinsanctuary.com/
#catcoin

🐾 What's new in every Catcoin Sanctuary launch:

🐈 Real cats only, fresh from viral X posts
🔑 Every new coin's address ends in "cats"
🎁 Creator fees go to the X account the cat's story came from, via @UsePaid (or to holders)

https://catcoinsanctuary.com/
